identity.statusNote: Canva AI is a feature set (Magic Studio) inside Canva, not a standalone product with its own pricing page.

sources.title: Canva AI page (fetch blocked by anti-bot, 403)

limits.en: 50 Magic Studio (AI) uses per month, limited Text to Image, Magic Write; Background Remover, Magic Eraser and Magic Expand are paid-plan-only.

keyLimits.en: 500 Magic Studio (AI) uses per month, unlimited Background Remover, Brand Kit, 100M+ premium assets
Per-user pricing, adds team collaboration and brand management features on top of Pro's AI allowance

cautions.en: Canva AI is not sold separately; its features and monthly usage caps (Magic Studio credits) are bundled into and gated by the underlying Canva Free/Pro/Business plan tier.

capabilities.en: AI image generation (Text to Image), background removal, object/element manipulation, and AI-assisted layout suggestions, bundled as 'Magic Studio' inside Canva.
Magic Write for AI-generated text/copy directly inside Canva designs.

limitations.en: Monthly usage caps on AI (Magic Studio) actions apply even on paid plans: 50/month on Free, 500/month on Pro.
Core AI removal/expansion tools (Background Remover, Magic Eraser, Magic Expand) are locked behind a paid plan entirely.

reason.en: Adobe's AI creative suite offering comparable generative image and design features.
AI image generation tool that overlaps with Canva AI's Text to Image capability.
